Team —

FYI I just received the note below from Skyline (external). Short version: they need to start a one-month pilot ASAP but procurement can’t issue POs for ~4–6 weeks. Pilot ARR ~12k/mo; likely 1–2 invoices in the window.

Proposal: approve a short-term "no-PO" onboarding for up to 60 days with conditions:
- W9 and COI provided (attached by Ethan)
- Signed order form / MSA executed before provisioning
- Invoices must reference our deal id (DEAL-3419) and be routed to payables@redwood.inference
- Net-30 payment terms; finance to flag vendor for close monitoring
- Procurement to create a vendor tag "no-po-temp" in ERP and cap exposure at $25k during the window

Risks: higher AR exposure and manual bookkeeping. Benefits: faster time-to-value and higher chance to convert to committed usage.

Marissa / Priyom — can you confirm if finance can accept those conditions and if legal/procurement need anything else before I respond? Hannah — please confirm the vendor tagging and cap approach.

Thanks,

Fine to proceed with a temporary exception under the conditions you listed, with a couple of additions from finance:

2) Signed order form or DocuSign acceptance of our Alternate Payment Agreement prior to provisioning. I've created a one-off DocuSign envelope here: https://docusign.com/envelopes/ALT-PA-3419 (please have the customer sign).
